intent.subtype: full-width product with explicit saturation slice
intent.rationale: The 16-bit product is held at full width; the narrowing to 8 bits is an explicit saturate-or-slice decision, so no value is silently lost.

labels.note: Product is evaluated at 16 bits and saturated explicitly.
